gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2010 reported a gross prior year reserve release of $9.646 million in 2015. This favorable development was primarily due to prior closed years running off satisfactorily, with releases from earlier years of account. Specific events like Hurricane Sandy (2012) and the 2013 Northern Europe summer storm season, which impacted the 2013 year of account, ran off as expected. The loss reserve for Malaysian Airways Flight MH370 (2014) remained stable. The syndicate also noted that earlier losses in New Zealand and Chile were being extinguished.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior closed years continue to run off satisfactorily both in the aggregate and individually, with all years but one contributing releases to the closing year result.

The losses that impacted the 2013 account, which were reported on in detail in last year's Annual Report, ran off as expected during 2015 and there were releases from the favourable run off of the earlier years of account that had closed into the 2013 account at 31 December 2014.
firming rates in our US property lines following Hurricane Sandy in 2012 maintained their momentum through the year.
An active summer storm season in Northern Europe caused some losses but a lack of major events in the US and elsewhere meant that the result for the year was a positive one.
Malaysian Airways Flight MH370, the cause of which remains a mystery although the loss reserve is stable.

Those pockets of opportunity created by earlier losses in places such as New Zealand and Chile are now quickly being extinguished as those markets which withdrew following the losses are now returning at lower rates.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: No explicit note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' presenting a single gross prior-year development figure was found. Management commentary and closed year results describe net releases and favourable run-off; the opening gross claims outstanding (2014 year-end) and closing gross claims outstanding (2015 year-end) are explicit. Prior-year development (gross) could not be reliably derived from the available movement notes and loss development tables without additional per-underwriting-year premium detail, so a single authoritative gross PYD figure is not reported (set to null). Some event impacts are mentioned narratively (e.g. MH370) but not quantified. Amounts are reported in the report's presentational currency (USD) and expressed in millions.
